summary.plain: A block of about 12,800 small plastic cubes, each paired with a thin screen that flashes when it catches a neutron, read out by light fibres, giving a three-dimensional picture of each antineutrino interaction.
summary.technical: Highly 3D-segmented detector: voxels of PVT plastic scintillator with 6LiF:ZnS(Ag) neutron screens read out by wavelength-shifting fibres and MPPCs; 1.6 t, in a lightproof shipping container with 50 cm HDPE and water-wall shielding.

technology.quote: whose basic detection unit combines two scintillators, PVT and 6LiF:ZnS(Ag), to measure antineutrinos via their inverse-beta-decay products
technology.value: Highly granular detector whose basic unit combines two scintillators, PVT and 6LiF:ZnS(Ag), read out by MPPCs
